items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And then I left Sarah Vaughan. ... '54, right, with Sarah. ... He was always hoping from then on that I’d be Sarah’s drummer. And she liked me. I went and did that.

ctx.x: And then I left Sarah Vaughan.

Okay. Let’s backtrack. So you’re already with Bird, doing Bird and strings. So, early ’50s. After you left Bird, or probably while you’re working with Bird, you’re working with some other folks then too.
